# 1089. Duplicate Zeros

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def duplicateZeros(self, arr):
        """
        :type arr: List[int]
        :rtype: None Do not return anything, modify arr in-place instead.
        """
        n = len(arr)
        p1, p2 = 0, 0
        while p2 < n:
            if arr[p1] == 0:
                p2 += 1
            p1 += 1
            p2 += 1
        p1 -= 1
        p2 -= 1
        while p1 >= 0:
            if p2 < n:
                arr[p2] = arr[p1]
            if arr[p1] == 0:
                p2 -= 1
                arr[p2] = 0
            p1 -= 1
            p2 -= 1
```
